blocks.explanation: Neurotechnology is folded into the Geometry of Living as geometric operators on a thermodynamic manifold. Electrophysiology (EEG/MEG) is the observable projection of internal probability current; neurofeedback and biofeedback are closed-loop manifold steering via operant conditioning; brain-computer interfaces extend the active state vector, uniting biological and synthetic agency; electrotherapy (TMS, tACS, DBS) is external electromagnetic-field perturbation that flattens maladaptive attractor wells. Whether biological or synthetic, if a technology perturbs the Markov blanket it is parsed geometrically — manipulating the metric tensor, diffusion profile, and energy dissipation of a living manifold.
